text:
maria: heads-up — planning to enable emerald-v1 in catalog for eu-west tonight during the 22:00 UTC change window. want a quick gating + telemetry handshake before we flip any traffic.
andrew: +1. what's the fallback ordering we want if emerald starts degrading?
maria: proposed fallback ladder: emerald-quant -> emerald-flat -> dawn-7b (legacy). keep emerald-quant as primary fallback because cost/latency similar.
raj: ok but emerald-quant has a slightly different tokenization, make sure routing does variant-normalize so prompts stay consistent.
olivia: observability checklist: 95p latency, p50/p95 token-per-second, 5xx rate, avg token cost, and sample-quality regression (we'll run the smoke eval set). set automated alert thresholds.
maria: alert thresholds suggested: >3% 5xx over 5m OR >25% p95 latency regression vs baseline -> auto-rollback. also manual rollback trigger if sample-quality drops >6% on smoke eval.
andrew: agree. add a soft-degrade policy first: if latency regresses 10% but 5xx <3% then reduce traffic to 30% for 10m and continue sampling.
raj: how do we want pins/drain semantics? I'm thinking pin the catalog entry to emerald-v1 for 10% traffic during canary, drain older variants from warm pools, and keep a pinlist for the EU region only until full cutover.
olmaria: typo — maria: yes pinlist for eu-west, canary traffic 10% for 20m, then 50% for 30m if metrics look good, then 100% at next maintenance window.
deploybot: DeployBot scheduled canary: model=emerald-v1 region=eu-west start=1736575200 (2024-11-10T22:00:00Z) traffic_phase=10% -> 50% -> 100% sequence. runbook-url=https://go/release/emerald-canary
andrew: @deploybot can you attach the telemetry dashboards to the thread and enable the smoke-eval job to run at the start of the canary?
deploybot: DeployBot: dashboards attached to canary run: /dashboards/emerald-canary, smoke-eval job queued. will post live updates here. :robot_face:
olivia: make sure span sampling is on for request/response latencies. also add example prompt set to smoke-eval that covers generation length extremes.
raj: +1 on sample diversity. i'll prepare the variant-normalize shim and post the rollout config in the morning.
maria: final ask: ops oncall (andrew) to be on standby for the window, product + trust (olivia) to watch quality signal, infra (raj) to monitor warm pool fills and drain behavior. call out rollback owner: andrew.
andrew: I'll take rollback ownership. quick note: rollback target = dawn-7b pinned at previous snapshot hash. we'll also unpin emerald variants after rollback.
deploybot: DeployBot: canary started (phase=10%) — ts=1736575200. posting periodic telemetry every 60s.
deploybot: DeployBot: telemetry snapshot: p95 latency +4%, 5xx 0.4%, sample-quality delta +0.8% (within tolerances). continuing.
maria: ack, continuing watch.
deploybot: DeployBot: phase->50% at ts=1736576400.
deploybot: DeployBot: telemetry snapshot: p95 latency +6% (baseline p95 220ms -> 234ms), 5xx 0.9%, sample-quality delta +1.2%. taking soft-degrade?
andrew: per runbook, p95 up 6% but 5xx <3% -> reduce traffic to 30% and extend observation 15m. initiate traffic-shift to 30% now.
deploybot: DeployBot: traffic adjusted to 30% per request by andrew. posting next snapshot in 60s.
raj: confirming drain behavior looks correct in pool logs; warm replicas reduced as expected. no OOMs.
olivia: running manual sample checks now, sending examples to thread in 2m.
deploybot: DeployBot: telemetry snapshot: p95 latency +5%, 5xx 0.6%, sample-quality delta +0.9% after adjustment.
maria: since metrics stabilized, we'll hold at 30% for 30m then re-evaluate for 50% -> full. if anything crosses rollback thresholds, andrew executes rollback.
andrew: will do. thanks everyone.
maria: thanks team — closing handshake. keep thread open for postmortem notes.
